profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at BigCommerce
profile.summary:
Currently, part of BigCommerce's Frontend Engineering team, empowering small, medium and large businesses alike to [SELL MORE!!]. BigCommerce is the most advanced e-commerce platform out there, and we are working every day to make it even better. Working on TS React frontends

Previously, I was a part of LinkedIn's Web Dev team, a part of LinkedIn Sales Solutions, and worked on the all-new LinkedIn Sales Navigator - empower[In]' sales professionals! While there, I was responsible for building features for LinkedIn's Sales Navigator, from scratch, using BackboneJS, Dust, and Play. Collaborating with designers and PMs alike to ensure Sales Nav's success.

My previous work as a Software Engineer at SEMHunt was focused on maintaining the production backend architecture operating correctly. Used Python and Bash to automate & monitor key processes. Also debugged front end JavaScript functionality, provisioned new virtual hosts and updated the production database via Python & Oracle SQL Developer as needed

Acquired the B.S. Engineering Physics degree at Instituto Tecnologico y de Estudios Superiores de Monterrey, in Monterrey, Mexico. Also spent the seventh semester abroad as an exchange student with the University of Toronto, (Ontario, Canada), where I took courses on numeric analysis using Python.

projects.title: LilyPond Front End Editor
projects.description:
LilyPond GUI is a music sheet editing software that provides a clean, easy to use interface to write music. It's philosophy is centered around the idea "what you see is what you mean", and also provides handy keyboard shortcuts to be as efficient as possible. It interfaces with LilyPond (a hugely popular markup language) to provide high quality PDF and MIDI files. It is available either as a desktop or web application, and is fully compatible between the two.

My specific contributions to the project include:
- Implemented the front end routing with Angular, and all user views using Bootstrap.
- Incorporated the app's functionality into the web version, including export and import compatibility with JSON and LY files
- Built the backend architecture using Node and Express, including the API needed by the front end


Created as a 3 week project while in Hack Reactor.
Technologies: CoffeeScript, Angular, Node.js, Express.js, Node-webkit.

projects.title: RASR
projects.description:
RASR is a 2-dimensional multiplayer online game that features map editor functionality that allows players to create and edit the map they play on, via a simple online interface. Users can also go around the world, explore what's in there and fight some monsters along the way, while having their own custom safe haven to come back to !

It runs entirely inside any modern browser, using JavaScript. The server side was implemented using Node with Express, and real time communications were made possible with HTML5's web sockets (using socket.io).

My specific contributions to the project include:
- Implemented the socket.io handlers for broadcasting and redirecting data towards other players.
- Used a custom event-driven system to receive updates about other player's actions.
- Developed the functionality of enemy characters and their respective interaction with players.
- Built the game logic that allows players to level up, gain attributes and various other benefits.

Created as a 3 week project while in Hack Reactor.
Technologies: CoffeeScript, Phaser, Angular, Node.js, Express.js, Socket.io, MongoDB, Mongoose.
